Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to disambiguate the film title "Lo Zappatore" in the initial step. The search results clearly indicated two distinct films: a 1950 film titled "Lo Zappatore" and a 1980 film titled "Zappatore" (with the plot description "A digger breaks his back..."). The Planner incorrectly assumed the 1980 film was irrelevant and that the 1950 film was the only candidate, without verifying if the 1980 film might be the intended subject or if the titles were interchangeable in common parlance. This led to a premature conclusion that "Lo Zappatore" was released in 1950, ignoring the possibility that the user might be referring to the 1980 film or that the titles were confused. This error propagated through subsequent steps, causing the Planner to repeatedly search for "Lo Zappatore 1950" and ignore the 1980 film, ultimately leading to an incorrect comparison with "Placer Sangriento".
